# blendops-lighting-materials (reference summary)

## Purpose
Plan lighting, materials, and color management, and check lighting and material quality against written criteria.

## Metadata & truth boundary
- **Canonical skill:** `skills/blendops-lighting-materials/SKILL.md`
- **Contract:** `skills/blendops-lighting-materials/contract.json` (`v2.0.0`)
- **Category / role:** `scene-planners` / `lighting-material-color-planner-and-checker`
- **Capability tier:** `L0`
- **Truth-state policy:** Runtime status defaults to `Not Run`; Artifact status defaults to `Not Produced`; mutation rule is `downgrade_only` (never upgrade without verified evidence).

## When to use
- Lighting or material choices need a plan.
- Color management (view transform, look) must be decided.
- Lighting or material quality needs a check against criteria.

## When not to use
- to claim final rendered quality or executed results → delegate to `blendops-camera` (`references/skills/blendops-camera.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-camera)
- to skip composition/camera context from blendops-camera → delegate to `blendops-camera` (`references/skills/blendops-camera.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-camera)
- composition / camera validation → delegate to `blendops-camera` (`references/skills/blendops-camera.md`; use blendops-camera)
- broad pass/warn/fail scene readiness → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; use blendops-final-check)
- classifying render or export artifact evidence → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; use blendops-final-check)
- to fix or edit lights (this skill validates and gives remediation hints only; it never edits) → delegate to `blendops-final-check` (`references/skills/blendops-final-check.md`; this skill validates and gives remediation hints only; it never edits)
- web integration and viewer handoff → delegate to `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skills/blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`; use blendops-glb-web-handoff)
- Post-render color grading or soft-proofing (handled by compositor / DCC after render). → delegate to `blendops-render-settings` (`references/skills/blendops-render-settings.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-render-settings)
- Selecting file formats or bit depths (blendops-render-settings). → delegate to `blendops-render-settings` (`references/skills/blendops-render-settings.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-render-settings)
- Choosing the render engine (blendops-render-settings). → delegate to `blendops-render-settings` (`references/skills/blendops-render-settings.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-render-settings)
- Raw modeling without lookdev (color management does not affect geometry accuracy). → delegate to `blendops-render-settings` (`references/skills/blendops-render-settings.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-render-settings)

## Inputs & output/evidence contract
### Required inputs
- `domain_scene_plan` (`object`): Upstream scene layout and subject surface description
- `camera_framing_plan` (`object`): Locked camera angles and hero silhouette requirements from blendops-camera

### Optional inputs
- `target_render_engine_hint` (`string`): Preferred engine (Cycles, Eevee, or WebGL/GLB PBR export target)
- `lighting_rig_specification` (`object`): Key-to-fill ratios, light placements, HDRI rotation, and shadow softness from blendops-lighting-materials
- `color_management_pins` (`object`): Pinned view transform (AgX/Filmic/Standard) and exposure target from blendops-lighting-materials
- `render_or_preview_exposure_notes` (`string`): Optional highlight clipping or shadow crush observations from preview output
- `material_and_shader_inventory` (`array`): Principled BSDF parameter ranges, texture maps, UV channels, and normal map conventions
- `target_consumption_surface` (`string`): Whether materials target offline Cycles/Eevee rendering or glTF 2.0 PBR web export
- `texture_memory_budget` (`object`): Maximum texture resolution and VRAM budget from blendops-glb-budget
- `target_delivery_pipeline` (`string`): Target display or compositing pipeline (web sRGB, product brand match, ACEScg VFX, HDR)
- `blender_version_posture` (`string`): Target Blender version family (3.6 LTS Filmic, 4.0+ AgX, 5.1+ AgX/ACES)
- `brand_hex_swatch_constraints` (`array`): Optional strict brand hex colors requiring Standard vs tone-mapped tradeoffs

### Primary outputs
- `key_fill_rim_lighting_plan`
- `pbr_material_and_roughness_spec`
- `hdri_and_reflection_strategy`
- `lighting_quality_verdict_table`
- `key_fill_rim_and_clipping_audit`
- `lighting_remediation_instructions`
- `pbr_material_verdict_table`
- `gltf_shader_portability_risks`
- `material_remediation_steps`
- `pinned_view_transform_and_look`
- `display_and_working_colorspace_spec`
- `cross_engine_and_web_color_caveats`
